/** * selectBannerMngList : isry.ytosp.portalmng.menuandprogrm.mapper.selectBannerMngList : 배너 목록조회 */ SELECT INDEX_SN , IMAGE_NM , IMAGE_CN , LC_SE_CD , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'LC_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = LC_SE_CD) AS LC_SE_CD_NM , URL_ADDR , TO_CHAR(BGNG_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS BGNG_DT , TO_CHAR(END_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS END_DT , PROGRM_USE_SE_CD , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'PROGRM_USE_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = PROGRM_USE_SE_CD) AS PROGRM_USE_SE_CD_NM , ATFINO , FRST_RGTR_ID , FRST_REG_DT , LAST_MDFR_ID , LAST_MDFCN_DT FROM PSA130 WHERE 1=1
AND BGNG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{startDate} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND END_DT <= TO_DATE(#{endDate} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')

/** * selectBannerMngDetail : isry.ytosp.portalmng.menuandprogrm.mapper.selectBannerMngDetail : 배너 상세조회 */ SELECT INDEX_SN , IMAGE_NM , IMAGE_CN , LC_SE_CD , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'LC_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = LC_SE_CD) AS LC_SE_CD_NM , URL_ADDR , TO_CHAR(BGNG_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS BGNG_DT , TO_CHAR(END_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS END_DT , PROGRM_USE_SE_CD , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'PROGRM_USE_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = PROGRM_USE_SE_CD) AS PROGRM_USE_SE_CD_NM , ATFINO , FRST_RGTR_ID , FRST_REG_DT , LAST_MDFR_ID , LAST_MDFCN_DT FROM PSA130 WHERE 1=1 AND INDEX_SN = #{INDEX_SN}
mapper.update: /** * deleteBannerMng : isry.couns.mngr.icbtgmng.mapper.deleteBannerMng : 배너 삭제 상태 update */ UPDATE PSA130 SET PROGRM_USE_SE_CD = 4 WHERE 1 = 1 AND INDEX_SN = #{INDEX_SN}

/** * updateBannerMng : isry.couns.mngr.icbtgmng.mapper.updateBannerMng : 배너 수정 */ UPDATE PSA130 SET IMAGE_NM = #{IMAGE_NM} /* 이미지명 */ , IMAGE_CN = #{IMAGE_CN} /* 이미지내용 */ , LC_SE_CD = #{LC_SE_CD} /* 위치구분코드 */ , URL_ADDR = #{URL_ADDR} /* URL주소 */ , BGNG_DT = #{BGNG_DT} /* 시작일시 */ , END_DT = #{END_DT} /* 종료일시 */ , PROGRM_USE_SE_CD = #{PROGRM_USE_SE_CD} /* 프로그램사용구분코드 */ , ATFINO = #{ATFINO} /* 첨부파일번호 */ , FRST_RGTR_ID = #{USER_ID} /* 최초등록자아이디 */ , FRST_REG_DT = SYSDATE /* 최초등록일시 */ , LAST_MDFR_ID = #{USER_ID} /* 최종수정자아이디 */ , LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE /* 최종수정일시 */ WHERE 1 = 1 AND INDEX_SN = #{INDEX_SN}
